_read: Zack's trading settings. Only Zack changes these (by hand on GitHub, or by telling Claude). kalshi.py reads them every run.
_mode: paper: log what it would trade, no orders. live: place real orders on Kalshi within the limits below. demo: same as live on Kalshi's demo exchange with mock funds.
_approved: Real or demo orders are only placed when approved is true and approvedAt is later than the last stop. A stop-loss or take-profit stop needs a new approval.
_startingBankroll: Dollars. Paper trading uses this too, so the paper record is sized like the real one.
_stopLoss: Dollars. Trading stops when equity falls this far below the starting bankroll.
_takeProfit: Dollars. Trading stops when equity rises this far above the starting bankroll.
_maxPerTradePct: Most of the current equity one trade can cost, in percent.
_maxPerDay: Dollars. Most that new trades can cost in one day (Central time).
_minEdge: Fair probability minus price minus fee, per dollar of contract. 0.02 = two cents of value per contract.
_priceBand: Only contracts priced inside this band. Extreme prices carry big fees relative to value and thin books.
_liveSources: Which signal sources may place real orders. official = any EDGE strategy grade.py has made official, mirrored onto Kalshi. Named sources (kalshi-sharp, kalshi-sharp-alt, mirror:wind-total, ...) can be added by Zack. Paper trading always logs every source.
